title: 第13章 前方施工请绕道行驶第14章 突破练气一层
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
忙碌了两个时辰，秦宇才将明月广场打扫干净。
在树荫下休息了一会儿，秦宇取出随身携带的纸和笔，将上面《从杂役弟子开始的成仙路》几个字划掉，改成《从铲粪开始的成仙路》！
他觉得这样的标题更容易吸引读者。
做完这些，秦宇也没有选择修炼。
他就盯着四周，看看到底是那个杀千刀的敢在他的地盘上随地大小便。
直到酉时，也就是下午五点。
秦宇听到远处传来一阵杂乱的声音，就像是乱七八糟很多动物凑在一起，什么声音都有。
‘有情况！
秦宇竖起耳朵，仔细观察。
声音由远及近，秦宇很快便看到声音的源头在哪。
那是一大群灵兽，什么灵兽都有，最大的是头大象，足足有四五米高。
此外天上飞的大鸟、地上跑的鸵鸟、羚羊、骏马、食铁兽等等。
每个灵兽身上都坐着一位玄天宗弟子。
此刻！
各种各样的灵兽浩浩荡荡的朝着秦宇的明月广场冲了过来。
“杀千刀的，可算找到你们了！”
秦宇噌的一下站起身，朝着灵兽队伍冲了过去。
“站住，你们给我停下！”
灵兽队伍急忙刹车，在秦宇身前一米处停了下来。
“找死吗？神经病啊！”

坐在大象身上的弟子站起身怒骂道。
秦宇深吸一口气，压下心中的怒火。
好声好气的说道：“你们就不能给你们的灵兽穿上文明兜啊，随地大小便也太没素质了。”
“文明兜，那是什么？”
秦宇：“就是兜住你们灵兽的排泄物的东西。”
闻言，坐在灵兽身上那些人顿时哈哈大笑起来。
为首者拍了拍自己的大象，说道：“我这撼地龙象一次能拉几百斤，你说什么兜能兜住啊？”
秦宇反驳道：“那你也不能让他乱拉吧，就不能提前上好厕所吗？我刚打扫干净的广场你们走一遍我就要重新清理。”
“呵！”
那人不屑笑道：“打扫卫生不就是你们这些杂役弟子该干的事吗？”
content_en:
After two hours of busy work, Qin Yu cleaned up Mingyue Square.
After resting under the shade of a tree for a while, Qin Yu took out the paper and pen he carried with him, crossed out the words "The road to becoming an immortal starts from being a handyman disciple" and changed it to "The road to becoming an immortal starts from shoveling dung"!
He feels that such a title is more likely to attract readers.
After doing this, Qin Yu did not choose to practice.
He just stared around to see who dared to defecate on his territory.
Until Youshi, which is five o'clock in the afternoon.
Qin Yu heard a chaotic sound coming from the distance, like many animals gathered together in a mess, and there were all kinds of sounds.
‘There’s a situation!
Qin Yu pricked up his ears and observed carefully.
The sound moved from far away to near, and Qin Yu quickly saw the source of the sound.
It was a large group of spiritual beasts, including all kinds of spiritual beasts. The largest one was an elephant, which was four to five meters tall.
In addition, there are big birds flying in the sky, ostriches running on the ground, antelopes, horses, iron-eating beasts, etc.
Each spiritual beast has a Xuantian Sect disciple sitting on it.
now!
Various spiritual beasts rushed towards Qin Yu's Mingyue Square.
"Thousands of Killers have finally found you!"
Qin Yu suddenly stood up and rushed towards the spirit beast team.
"Stop, stop it!"
The team of spirit beasts braked quickly and stopped one meter in front of Qin Yu.
"Are you looking for death? You're crazy!"
The disciple sitting on the elephant stood up and cursed angrily.
Qin Yu took a deep breath and suppressed the anger in his heart.
He said angrily: "You can't put civilized clothes on your spirit beasts. It's too unqualified to defecate anywhere."
"Wenming Kabuto, what is that?"
Qin Yu: "It's the thing that holds the excrement of your spiritual beasts."
Hearing this, the people sitting on the spirit beast burst into laughter.
The leader patted his elephant and said: "My earth-shaking dragon elephant can pull hundreds of kilograms at a time. What kind of bag can you carry?"
Qin Yu retorted: "Then you can't let him poop. Can't you go to the toilet in advance? I'll clean up the square I just cleaned once you walk through it."
"Ha!"
The man smiled disdainfully and said, "Isn't cleaning what you, the handyman disciples, should do?"
